steps.title: Analyze Manifest Merger Error
steps.description: Inspect AndroidManifest.xml and identify namespace issues related to the deprecated package attribute.

steps.title: Remove Deprecated Package Attribute
steps.description: Remove the package attribute from the manifest tag as recommended by AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Fully Qualify Activity Names
steps.description: Update MainActivity declaration in AndroidManifest.xml to use its fully qualified name to avoid merger ambiguity.

steps.title: Analyze Java Compilation Issues
steps.description: Inspect MainActivity.java for any deliberate syntax errors or typos that prevent successful compilation.

steps.title: Resolve Deliberate Typo
steps.description: Remove the deliberate typo statement inside the onCreate method of MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure MainActivity.java uses standard Java 8 compatible API calls and standard Activity lifecycle methods.

steps.title: Validate Resource References
steps.description: Confirm that setContentView(R.layout.activity_main) correctly references activity_main.xml layout resource.

steps.title: Verify App Metadata Configuration
steps.description: Ensure app-meta.json specifies the correct application name and package identifier.

steps.title: Prepare Project Configuration
steps.description: Confirm that Gradle settings match the fixed build environment (AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5).

steps.title: Building Compile Fail Demo
steps.description: Trigger gradle assembleDebug to compile the application and produce a valid, working debug APK.
